_note: Paper numbers (Tables 3/4; n_terms counted from Tables B.6/B.7) are for the paper's materials, Treloar rubber at 20 C and human cortex. The gym scores the same protocol on more materials from the same studies: scores.json reproduces the paper's two materials; scoring/scores_train.json (development side) averages over rubber_T20 and brain_CX + brain_CC; the hidden test averages over rubber_T50 and brain_CR + brain_BG, so its values are not on the paper's scale.
_scale_note: Per-metric improvements are divided by their spread across ranked attempts, so coefficients set relative importance, not units.

rubber_generalization.description: Rubber, positive-exponent family (I1-like generalized invariants). Fit uniaxial + equibiaxial tension, predict held-out pure shear. Paper: GI-CANN discovers alpha* = 1.675 and beats SI-CANN (alpha fixed at 2).

r2_ut.description: Coefficient of determination of the uniaxial tension stress, clipped to [0, 1] as in the paper, averaged over the experiment's materials (enters avg_r2).

r2_bt.description: Coefficient of determination of the equibiaxial tension stress, clipped to [0, 1] as in the paper, averaged over the experiment's materials (enters avg_r2).

r2_ps.description: Coefficient of determination of the pure shear (held out) stress, clipped to [0, 1] as in the paper, averaged over the experiment's materials.

avg_r2.description: Mean of the three clipped per-mode R2 (two training modes + held-out mode), the paper's Table 3/4 metric, averaged over the experiment's materials.

heldout_rel_error.description: Mean relative stress error |s - s_hat| / |s_hat| over the loaded points of the held-out mode (each point capped at 1), the paper's Fig. 4/5 measure; weights the small-strain response that R2 hardly sees.

n_terms.description: Constraint: number of active strain-energy terms (stress contribution >= 1% of a mode's measured stress range). The paper's claim is accuracy without giving up a compact, interpretable law; dense expansions pay here. Laws with more than 12 active terms are invalid.

alpha_star.description: Exponent of the dominant term, report only (zero coefficient: matching the paper's exponent is not rewarded).

rubber_negative_ablation.description: Rubber, negative-exponent family only (I2-like). Mismatched family: the paper finds it fails for rubber.
